verdicts.opus: C and D both grounded their answers in the radar call. C used more of it: it quantified the research and news trends with ratios and the news peak, listed all ten DOI-linked works, and read the under-coverage zeros correctly. D omitted the news series and misread the direction of the framing shift in its verdict. A and B were honest memory-only answers with no measured support; B added labelled estimates that understate the recorded growth.
verdicts.gpt: D offers the broadest decision-grade picture: it connects research and news trends, framing, recent papers, and taxonomy results while explaining what those counts cannot establish. Its numerical coverage and drill-down are stronger than B’s, though an orientation-count error and unsupported peak caveat weaken its accuracy; B is the cleaner, more restrained alternative.

claude_bare: Memory estimates (around 10k papers per year by the mid-2020s, about 20% CAGR) conflict with the record (24,885 papers in 2025, 29.0% CAGR).
claude_prism: Says four of the top ten are labelled 'promising'. The record has five promising, four descriptive and one problem_identifying.
chatgpt_prism: The verdict describes a 'shift toward cautionary framing', but the cautionary share declined from 10.3% to 8.3%.

claude_prism.chart: The single endpoint chart traces. News volume and framing are not charted.
claude_prism.drilldown: One traced layer: 10 works with DOIs plus topic counts. Only 3 of 6 follow-ups executed and none were folded back into the report.
claude_prism.export: Two traced CSVs with provenance. The new_work.csv lacks DOI identifiers.
claude_prism.repro: 58 of 58 numbers trace, there is a calls block, and derived figures recompute (7.7x, 1.7, 19.9 pp).

claude_prism.limits: Limits sit next to the numbers: window gaps, censoring, match mode, and the meaning of the under-covered zero counts.

claude_prism.facets: Covers trend, news, new work, framing and under-coverage. It does not address the drones vs AI vs IoT speed contrast.

claude_prism.trend: The sourced research series includes a stated window, quantified growth and late/early comparison, but drops the full monthly news points and censoring detail.
claude_prism.comparison: The research and news late/early ratios are separately computed and caveated for their differing windows and units.
claude_prism.chart: The endpoint chart traces to the source, fits the time series, and supports a claim, but lacks intermediate points and visible censoring.
claude_prism.drilldown: It exposes papers and taxonomy items with identifiers, but only three follow-up calls succeed and no follow-up result is folded in.
claude_prism.export: The exports trace and have provenance, but omit required detailed monthly and complete series fields.
claude_prism.repro: Every number traces and the call arguments and capture date are supplied in a regenerate block.
